title: Cümleler 14: Olay anlatma: ne oluyordu?
intro:
Bu cümleler çoğunlukla Past Continuous (was / were + -ing) ile kurulur; 17. aşamayı bitirdiyseniz hepsini anlarsınız. Uzun süren arka plan eylemi -ing ile, araya giren kısa olay düz geçmiş zamanla söylenir: I was cooking when the phone rang. Önce cümleyi, sonra altındaki konuşmayı sesli tekrar edin.

Konuşmada was ve were zayıf okunur: was «{w}ız», were «{w}ı». Olumsuzda ve kısa cevapta tam okunur: wasn't «[{w}o]-zınt», Yes, I was. «yes ay [{w}oz]». Bir olayı anlatırken arka planı önce verin (It was raining…), sonra olayı söyleyin.

words.en: What were you doing at eight last night?
words.tr: Dün akşam saat sekizde ne yapıyordun?
words.example: What were you doing at eight last night? — I was at the gym.
words.exampleTr: Dün akşam saat sekizde ne yapıyordun? — Spor salonundaydım.

words.en: I was watching a film with Kate.
words.example: Why didn't you answer? — Sorry, I was watching a film with Kate.
words.exampleTr: Neden açmadın? — Kusura bakma, Kate'le film izliyordum.

words.en: I was having a shower when the phone rang.
words.example: Why didn't you pick up? — I was having a shower when the phone rang.
words.exampleTr: Neden açmadın? — Telefon çaldığında duş alıyordum.
words.note: ring → rang: telefon çaldı. Duş “almak” İngilizcede have a shower; “take” Amerikan

words.en: Sorry, I wasn't listening.
words.example: So what do you think? — Sorry, I wasn't listening.
words.exampleTr: Peki sen ne düşünüyorsun? — Kusura bakma, dinlemiyordum.

words.en: What were you two talking about?
words.example: What were you two talking about? — Oh, nothing important.
words.exampleTr: Siz ikiniz ne konuşuyordunuz? — Hiç, önemli bir şey değil.

words.en: It was raining when we left the house.
words.example: Why are you so wet? — It was raining when we left the house.
words.exampleTr: Neden bu kadar ıslaksın? — Evden çıktığımızda yağmur yağıyordu.

words.en: The sun was shining all day.
words.example: How was the weather at the seaside? — Lovely. The sun was shining all day.
words.exampleTr: Deniz kenarında hava nasıldı? — Harika. Bütün gün güneş parlıyordu.

words.en: While I was walking home, I saw a fox.
words.example: While I was walking home, I saw a fox. — Really? In the middle of town?
words.exampleTr: Eve yürürken bir tilki gördüm. — Gerçekten mi? Şehrin ortasında mı?
words.note: while «{w}ayl» + uzun eylem (-ing); kısa olay düz geçmiş: saw

words.en: I dropped my mobile while I was getting off the bus.
words.read: ay [dropt] may mou-bayl {w}ayl ay {w}ız ge-ting [of] {d}ı bas
words.example: What happened to your screen? — I dropped my mobile while I was getting off the bus.
words.exampleTr: Ekranına ne oldu? — Otobüsten inerken telefonumu düşürdüm.

words.en: Everyone was laughing at me.
words.example: Why did you leave the party? — Everyone was laughing at me.
words.exampleTr: Partiden neden ayrıldın? — Herkes bana gülüyordu.

words.en: Were you sleeping when I called?
words.example: Were you sleeping when I called? — Yes, I was. It was really late.
words.exampleTr: Aradığımda uyuyor muydun? — Evet, uyuyordum. Çok geçti.

words.en: No, I was just reading in bed.
words.example: Did I wake you up? — No, I was just reading in bed.
words.exampleTr: Seni uyandırdım mı? — Hayır, sadece yatakta kitap okuyordum.

words.en: Who were you talking to on the phone?
words.example: Who were you talking to on the phone? — My mum. She says hello.
words.exampleTr: Telefonda kiminle konuşuyordun? — Annemle. Sana selamı var.

words.en: You'll never guess what happened!
words.example: You'll never guess what happened! — Go on, tell me!
words.exampleTr: Ne oldu, tahmin bile edemezsin! — Hadi, anlat!
words.note: Bir hikâyeye başlamak için çok kullanılır

words.en: I wasn't looking where I was going.
words.example: How did you fall? — I wasn't looking where I was going.
words.exampleTr: Nasıl düştün? — Nereye gittiğime bakmıyordum.
words.note: where'in r'si, ardından sesli harf gelince okunur: «{w}eır ay»

words.en: Was anyone hurt?
words.example: Two cars crashed outside our house. — Was anyone hurt? — No, everyone was fine, luckily.
words.exampleTr: Evimizin önünde iki araba çarpıştı. — Yaralanan oldu mu? — Hayır, neyse ki herkes iyiydi.

words.en: The bus was going too fast.
words.example: How did the accident happen? — The bus was going too fast.
words.exampleTr: Kaza nasıl oldu? — Otobüs çok hızlı gidiyordu.

words.en: A man was standing outside our door.
words.example: A man was standing outside our door. — Did you know him?
words.exampleTr: Kapımızın önünde bir adam duruyordu. — Tanıyor muydun?

words.en: What was he wearing?
words.example: I saw your brother in town. — Really? What was he wearing?
words.exampleTr: Kardeşini şehirde gördüm. — Sahi mi? Üstünde ne vardı?

words.en: He was wearing a long black coat.
words.example: What was he wearing? — He was wearing a long black coat.
words.exampleTr: Üstünde ne vardı? — Uzun siyah bir palto giyiyordu.

words.en: The kids were playing in the garden.
words.example: Where were the kids? — The kids were playing in the garden.
words.exampleTr: Çocuklar neredeydi? — Çocuklar bahçede oynuyordu.

words.en: I was cooking dinner when the lights went out.
words.example: I was cooking dinner when the lights went out. — Oh no! What did you do?
words.exampleTr: Işıklar gittiğinde akşam yemeği pişiriyordum. — Eyvah! Ne yaptın?

words.en: We were sitting in the dark for an hour.
words.example: Did the power come back quickly? — No, we were sitting in the dark for an hour.
words.exampleTr: Elektrik çabuk geldi mi? — Hayır, bir saat karanlıkta oturduk.

words.en: I was driving to work when I got a puncture.
words.example: Why were you so late? — I was driving to work when I got a puncture.
words.exampleTr: Neden bu kadar geç kaldın? — İşe giderken lastiğim patladı.

words.en: The train was moving really slowly.
words.example: Why are you late? — The train was moving really slowly.
words.exampleTr: Neden geç kaldın? — Tren çok yavaş gidiyordu.

words.en: I was half asleep when you rang.
words.example: You sounded strange this morning. — I was half asleep when you rang.
words.exampleTr: Bu sabah sesin tuhaf geliyordu. — Aradığında yarı uykudaydım.
words.note: British konuşmada “aramak” için “ring” de çok kullanılır: ring → rang

words.en: What were you thinking?
words.example: I left my bag on the train. — What were you thinking?
words.exampleTr: Çantamı trende unuttum. — Aklından ne geçiyordu?

words.en: I wasn't thinking, sorry.
words.example: Why did you tell her? — I wasn't thinking, sorry.
words.exampleTr: Ona neden söyledin? — Düşünemedim, kusura bakma.

words.en: Were they arguing again?
words.example: I heard shouting next door. — Were they arguing again?
words.exampleTr: Yan evden bağırışlar duydum. — Yine mi tartışıyorlardı?

words.en: The neighbours were shouting all night.
words.example: You look tired. — The neighbours were shouting all night.
words.exampleTr: Yorgun görünüyorsun. — Komşular bütün gece bağırıyordu.

words.en: The music was so loud, I couldn't hear anything.
words.tr: Müzik o kadar yüksekti ki hiçbir şey duyamıyordum.
words.example: Did you hear what he said? — No. The music was so loud, I couldn't hear anything.
words.exampleTr: Ne dediğini duydun mu? — Hayır. Müzik o kadar yüksekti ki hiçbir şey duyamıyordum.
words.note: Olumsuz cümlede anything: ✔ I couldn't hear anything. ✘ I couldn't hear nothing.

words.en: Somebody was knocking at the door.
words.example: Why did you wake up? — Somebody was knocking at the door.
words.exampleTr: Neden uyandın? — Biri kapıyı çalıyordu.

words.en: I was just thinking about you!
words.example: Hi, it's Emma! — Emma! I was just thinking about you!
words.exampleTr: Selam, ben Emma! — Emma! Ben de tam seni düşünüyordum!

words.en: Where were you going in such a hurry?
words.example: I saw you in the street this morning. Where were you going in such a hurry? — To the station. I was late.
words.exampleTr: Bu sabah seni sokakta gördüm. O telaşla nereye gidiyordun? — İstasyona. Geç kalmıştım.

words.en: I was running to catch my train.
words.example: Why didn't you stop and say hello? — I was running to catch my train.
words.exampleTr: Neden durup selam vermedin? — Trenimi yakalamak için koşuyordum.

words.en: I wasn't paying attention.
words.example: How did you miss your stop? — I wasn't paying attention.
words.exampleTr: Durağını nasıl kaçırdın? — Dikkat etmiyordum.

words.en: I was looking for my keys for ten minutes.
words.read: ay {w}ız [lu]-king fı may [kiiz] fı ten mi-nits
words.example: Why are you late? — I was looking for my keys for ten minutes.
words.exampleTr: Neden geç kaldın? — On dakika boyunca anahtarlarımı aradım.

words.en: They were in my pocket the whole time!
words.example: Did you find your keys? — Yes. They were in my pocket the whole time!
words.exampleTr: Anahtarlarını buldun mu? — Evet. Meğer baştan beri cebimdeymiş!

words.en: Were you working late yesterday?
words.tr: Dün geç saate kadar çalışıyor muydun?
words.example: Were you working late yesterday? — Yes, until nine.
words.exampleTr: Dün geç saate kadar çalışıyor muydun? — Evet, dokuza kadar.

words.en: At midnight I was still working.
words.example: Did you finish your report? — Yes, but at midnight I was still working.
words.exampleTr: Raporunu bitirdin mi? — Evet ama gece yarısı hâlâ çalışıyordum.

words.en: The baby was crying for hours.
words.example: Did you sleep well? — Not really. The baby was crying for hours.
words.exampleTr: İyi uyudun mu? — Pek değil. Bebek saatlerce ağladı.
words.note: for'un r'si, ardından sesli harf gelince okunur: «fır au-ız»

words.en: I was trying to sleep!
words.example: Why are you angry? — I was trying to sleep!
words.exampleTr: Neden kızgınsın? — Uyumaya çalışıyordum!

words.en: While we were having lunch, it started to rain.
words.tr: Biz öğle yemeği yerken yağmur başladı.
words.example: How was the picnic? — While we were having lunch, it started to rain.
words.exampleTr: Piknik nasıldı? — Biz öğle yemeği yerken yağmur başladı.

words.en: I saw Emma while I was shopping.
words.example: I saw Emma while I was shopping. — How is she?
words.exampleTr: Alışveriş yaparken Emma'yı gördüm. — Nasılmış?

words.en: I was so embarrassed!
words.example: I called my teacher “Mum” in class. — Oh no! — I was so embarrassed!
words.exampleTr: Sınıfta öğretmenime “Anne” dedim. — Eyvah! — Çok utandım!

words.en: Everybody was dancing when we arrived.
words.example: Was the party good? — Great! Everybody was dancing when we arrived.
words.exampleTr: Parti iyi miydi? — Harika! Biz vardığımızda herkes dans ediyordu.

words.en: I fell asleep while I was watching TV.
words.example: Did you see the end of the match? — No, I fell asleep while I was watching TV.
words.exampleTr: Maçın sonunu gördün mü? — Hayır, televizyon izlerken uyuyakaldım.
words.note: Uykuya dalmak kısa olay → fell; izlemek uzun eylem → was watching

words.en: Sorry, were you saying something?
words.example: Sorry, were you saying something? — Yes, I asked if you want tea.
words.exampleTr: Pardon, bir şey mi diyordun? — Evet, çay ister misin diye sordum.

words.en: I was only joking!
words.example: That wasn't very nice! — I was only joking!
words.exampleTr: Bu hiç hoş değildi! — Sadece şaka yapıyordum!

words.en: We weren't doing anything wrong.
words.example: What were you doing in there? — Nothing! We weren't doing anything wrong.
words.exampleTr: Orada ne yapıyordunuz? — Hiçbir şey! Yanlış bir şey yapmıyorduk.
